sources.note: The list starts at the retrieval date; earlier dates (?date=YYYYMMDD) sit behind an AWS WAF bot challenge
Upcoming shows only; past shows are not listed

notes: BU Men's Ice Hockey vs. Denver on 2026-11-27: goterriers lists 18:00, agganisarena lists 15:00 (kept goterriers)
Times are America/New_York with the offset in effect on that date (EDT -04:00 until 2026-11-01, EST -05:00 after).
BU home games come from goterriers.com schedules; neutral-site games (e.g. Beanpot at TD Garden) are excluded.
attendance is the published box-score figure for games already played; soldOut is set only when a source says so (no source currently marks sold-out events).
referenceEvents holds 2025-26 BU home games (before the calendar window) with published attendance, for calibration.
Agganis campus-data events are student productions in the Student Theater at Agganis Arena (a small space, not the arena bowl), so their setup is null.

Agganis Arena's own calendar lists only dates from the retrieval day on; earlier dates are behind an AWS WAF bot challenge, so past non-BU Agganis events (2026-09-01 to the retrieval date) may be missing.
Live Nation lists only upcoming MGM Music Hall shows, so past MGM shows in the window are missing.
Agganis capacities from the arena's Capacity & Specifications page; theatre = upper bound of its 1,500-3,500 range.
